correctness.rationale: Reconstructed first-event decomposition: odd cycles cannot be perfectly rim-matched; even n=2m+2 has hub probability q_m/(1+lambda), where (2(1+lambda)m-1)q_m=sum_j q_j q_(m-1-j). Substitution f=-2aU'/U in 2azf'=f-1+zf^2 yields the exact 0F1 ratio. U=1-sum positive c_j z^j has one simple positive radius-minimizing zero rho>1 and no other zero on its circle; residue gives P=2 rho^(-m-1)+ exponentially smaller error. Coefficient monotonicity in a proves increasing rho. Independently rebuilt full occupied-mask absorbing-chain probabilities for rim lengths 3..10 at rates 1/3,1,2 and compared exactly with the path recurrence (24 checks PASS). Tests corroborate, not prove, the all-n and all-positive-real-rate statement.
